$comment: ORCH-1383 gate registry. GENERATED by YAML-parsing .github/workflows/*.yml — never grep (SPEC §1.1-D).
Every .mjs under .github/scripts/strict-grep/ (recursive, incl. __tests__/) has EXACTLY ONE entry:
I-PROPOSED-1383-GATE-MANIFEST-TOTALITY. Entries whose script lives elsewhere in the repo are gates the
strict-grep workflow invokes from outside this directory; they are registered so run-batch.mjs executes
'modes' is the exact set of invocation forms CI uses for that script — 2 gates are --self-test ONLY and
must never gain a plain run; 229 are plain-only; 186 run both. Changing modes changes WHAT is asserted.
'jobKeys' preserves the PRE-BATCH job identity so a failure can still name its origin (SPEC §5.1).
Ratchets (selfTestWiredFloor, unenforcedCap, gates[]) are append-only — enforced by
meta-1383-manifest-parity.mjs P7/P8 and by tests-append-only.yml. Shrinking needs a GATE-REMOVAL: token.
ORCH-1400 additions: fixtureCap caps enforcement:"fixture" rows (P10); capableUnwiredCap caps
selfTest:"capable-unwired" rows (P12); externalGateDirs lists dirs OUTSIDE strict-grep swept for
totality (P11, append-only list). Every fixture/unenforced reason MUST cite an ORCH-#### (P10).
All three caps are hard: raising one is a visible MANIFEST diff — there is no bypass token (OQ-2).
